mapper.sql: ID as id, INVITATION_ID as invitationId, TENANT_REF_ID as tenantRefId, INVITER_MEMBER_REF_ID as inviterMemberRefId, INVITEE_USER_REF_ID as inviteeUserRefId, STATUS as status, EXPIRES_AT as expiresAt, IS_DELETE as isDelete, CREATED_TIME as createdTime, CREATOR_ID as creatorId, MODIFY_TIME as modifyTime, MODIFIER_ID as modifierId, DELETED_AT as deletedAt, DELETED_BY_REF_ID as deletedByRefId, VERSION as version
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PEACH_TENANT_INVITATION (ID, INVITATION_ID, TENANT_REF_ID, INVITER_MEMBER_REF_ID, INVITEE_USER_REF_ID, STATUS, EXPIRES_AT, IS_DELETE, CREATED_TIME, CREATOR_ID, VERSION) VALUES (#{id}, #{invitationId}, #{tenantRefId}, #{inviterMemberRefId}, #{inviteeUserRefId}, 'PENDING', #{expiresAt}, 0, #{createdTime}, #{creatorId}, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT I.TENANT_REF_ID FROM PEACH_TENANT_INVITATION I INNER JOIN PEACH_TENANT T ON T.ID = I.TENANT_REF_ID AND T.STATUS = 'ENABLE' AND T.IS_DELETE = 0 WHERE I.ID = #{id} AND I.INVITEE_USER_REF_ID = #{userRefId} AND I.STATUS = 'PENDING' AND I.IS_DELETE = 0 AND I.EXPIRES_AT > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
SELECT FROM PEACH_TENANT_INVITATION WHERE ID = #{id} AND TENANT_REF_ID = #{tenantRefId} AND STATUS = 'PENDING' AND IS_DELETE = 0 AND EXPIRES_AT > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
mapper.update: UPDATE PEACH_TENANT_INVITATION SET STATUS = 'CANCELLED', IS_DELETE = 1, DELETED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), DELETED_BY_REF_ID = #{operatorRefId}, VERSION = VERSION + 1 WHERE ID = #{id} AND TENANT_REF_ID = #{tenantRefId} AND VERSION = #{version} AND STATUS = 'PENDING' AND IS_DELETE = 0
